name: Brali reviewed outcome observations
description: Versioned public observations accepted only after explicit consent, schema validation, privacy review and provenance review. The empty array is an observed zero, not a placeholder for synthetic usage.
notes: No demo, test, generated, analytics or repository event belongs in this file.
A downloaded event or prepared issue draft does not become a public observation automatically.
Negative, not-helpful, bad-match and no-answer outcomes are eligible when they meet the same privacy and provenance rules.
Interactive feedback collection is not live yet; collection_status remains contract-ready until that path is verified.
